description.en: Closes/frees a sound handle opened with one of the CMND_SND_OPEN_* commands, optionally fading it out first.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Close a sound handle with a fade-out
CMND_SND_CLOSE(hMapsnd, 30);
